log.speaker: narrator
text: DAY BOOK. '...Anders and Suvari in the mess over the amplifier core. Separated them. Core impounded in my locker on the Administrator's order until someone decides.'
'...Stores count is off again. Rations, two fuel cells. Marlow's manifests balance to the gram. Nobody's manifests balance to the gram.'
'...Abara walking the Ring at 04:10. Third night. Asked if he was all right. He said the ice was loud.'
